def differ_by_one_bit(a: int, b: int, bits: int = 32) -> bool:
    """Return True if a and b differ by exactly one bit within the given bit width."""
    mask = (1 << bits) - 1
    a_masked = a & mask
    b_masked = b & mask
    diff = a_masked ^ b_masked
    return diff != 0 and (diff & (diff - 1)) == 0

        clean = re.sub(r"[-']", "", word)  # strip internal hyphens/apostrophes
        if len(clean) >= min_len:
            result.append(word)

    n = len(s)

    pi = [0] * n

import heapq
from typing import List, Iterable, Any

def n_smallest_sort(data: Iterable[Any], n: int) -> List[Any]:
    """Return the n smallest items by sorting the entire dataset."""
    return sorted(data)[:n]

def n_smallest_heap(data: Iterable[Any], n: int) -> List[Any]:
    """Return the n smallest items using a heap (heapq.nsmall)."""
    if n <= 0:
        return []

    t_sort = time.time() - t0

    t0 = time.time()
    _ = n_smallest_heap(data, n)
    t_heap = time.time() - t0

    print(f"Sort method time: {t_sort:.6f}s")
    print(f"Heap method time: {t_heap:.6f}s")

if __name__ == "__main__":

    sorted_output: bool = True,

) -> List[Any]:
    """
    Return the n smallest items from *data*.

    Parameters
    ----------
    data : iterable
        Source collection.
    n : int
        Number of smallest items to retrieve.
    key : callable, optional
        Function to extract a comparison key from each element.
    sorted_output : bool, default True
        If True, result is sorted in ascending order according to the key.
        If False, order reflects original appearance (or heap order when include_ties=False).
    include_ties : bool, default True
        If True, all items that tie with the n‑th smallest value are included,

    smallest_n = heapq.nsmallest(n, seq, key=key)
